prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Create a beautifully art-directed, pixel-sharp desktop web application UI mockup for Skying, a sunset forecast tool for everyday sunset watchers. One single complete browser-content canvas, 1536x1024 landscape, no device frame, no perspective. This is a functioning-looking app design, not a poster. Precision camera viewfinder / light meter visual world interpreted as modern minimal web UI, unusually considered and premium.

LAYOUT: light cool silver #e9edf0 page ground, 64px margins. Slim 72px top header with existing italic serif wordmark "Skying" at left, a fine small text "Sunset forecast" next to it, location search field at right reading "San Francisco, California" and a compact "Find" button. Below header, spacious two-column title band: on left small plain text "Thursday, September 17 · Example forecast", below this a crisp dark ink sans-serif headline "An evening worth going out for." no more than 2 lines. On right clean score "84" large with small "/100" and verbal verdict "Excellent". Maintain hierarchy: headline 46px, score 76px, body 16px. No tiny illegible text.

Below that, one panoramic photographic sunset window full width approximately x64 y260 width1408 height320. Realistic evocative ocean horizon at dusk, immense cinematic pale peach clouds in silver-blue sky, small amber setting sun right of center, dark distant coastline low at left. Photographic natural texture not CSS gradients. The photo is illustrative and must have a tiny caption BELOW image reading "An impression of the evening, not a live view". No heavy text on photograph, no badges. Minimal delicate viewfinder corner marks to frame the landscape, no ornamental tech noise. Immediately below photo a silver instrument strip: "Best viewing window" / "18:48–19:23" at left, a thin restrained horizontal time ruler in center, "Sunset" / "19:12" at right. Small amber marker belongs to the time ruler. Ruler is a temporal visualization, not a score/progress bar.

Lower region y680 onwards: left two-thirds "Seven-day outlook" with seven clean flush selectable day columns, no separate bubble cards, dates "Today", "Fri", "Sat", "Sun", "Mon", "Tue", "Wed", scores "84", "76", "91", "68", "73", "82", "79". Today subtly filled pale terracotta with dark text. Short quality names beneath scores. On right about one-third "Why it looks promising" and paragraph "High clouds can catch the last light. A clear western horizon gives the colour room to develop." Beneath two quiet metrics "Horizon clarity 88%" and "Visibility 24 km". A footer disclosure control "Photography details +" along the bottom. Footer small "Forecasts are estimates. All times are local."

TYPOGRAPHY: exceptionally refined contemporary grotesk sans like Satoshi or Neue Montreal, dark blue-black #202d35, tabular numerals, disciplined whitespace, restrained same-family weights, left-aligned prose. Preserve the italic serif Skying wordmark only. One warm burnt amber #c86432 accent for selected controls. No purple, no warm cream, no black section, no decorative gradients, no generic card grid, no fake browser chrome, no random icons, no invented branding. Thin cool-gray rules only when useful. Search control softly squared radius 8px. Make it extremely polished, inviting, and practical. Match all stated text carefully.
